okaru.name: OKARU
okaru.desc: Modular retail software system. Inventory, sales, financial management and more in an integrated, scalable platform.

star.s: Retailers needed a robust, scalable, and maintainable commercial management solution without relying on costly enterprise alternatives.
star.t: Design and deliver a modular software architecture covering inventory, sales, and financial management as a SaaS product.
star.a: Led the technical design and implementation of independent modules using Laravel and React Native, ensuring seamless integration and commercial flexibility for clients of different sizes.
star.r: Delivered a functional, commercializable MVP with a modular structure that simplifies future updates, reduces maintenance cost, and enables market expansion.

auto.name: Autopictograma
auto.desc: Academic research on assistive communication automation. Uses OCR and NLP to generate pictograms from text, helping people with ASD and cerebral palsy.

star.s: AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) users faced autonomy barriers in restaurants because setting up pictogram menus required slow, manual configuration.
star.t: Automate the generation of pictogram boards directly from photos of physical restaurant menus.
star.a: Built a Computer Vision pipeline using OCR (Tesseract) and NLP models (spaCy + Prodigy) to extract and classify food entities from raw menu text — developed as part of a Master's research partnership with Livox.
star.r: Achieved 74.43% precision in item identification, eliminating manual entry and significantly reducing setup time for AAC users.

americanas.name: Large-Scale Systems – Americanas S.A.
americanas.desc: Senior Full Stack Developer on high-traffic e-commerce products serving millions of users. Checkout flows, customer-facing features, and internal sales ecosystem tools.

star.s: Americanas S.A.'s e-commerce platform needed to continuously evolve to handle massive traffic spikes and improve customer experience at national scale.
star.t: Operate as a Senior Full Stack Developer across multiple high-visibility products, ensuring quality, performance, and continuous delivery.
star.a: Developed and maintained customer-facing features and checkout flows using ReactJS, TypeScript, and Angular on the front end, and PHP/Laravel on the back end, deployed on AWS infrastructure with Docker containers.
star.r: Delivered scalable, reliable solutions directly impacting the experience of millions of users on Brazil's largest e-commerce platform.

education.name: Tech Education – UNINASSAU
education.desc: University professor designing practical curricula for Web and Mobile Development. Training the next generation of developers with real-world stacks and progressive assessments.

star.s: The job market demanded developers proficient in modern stacks, yet university curricula often lagged behind industry practices.
star.t: Design practical course materials and level-progressive assessments for Web Programming and Mobile Development disciplines (levels 1 & 2).
star.a: Created hands-on content and evaluations at progressive difficulty (levels 3–7) using real-world stacks: React Native, Flutter, PHP, HTML/CSS, and Git Flow workflows.
star.r: Students graduated with practical skills in industry-standard frameworks, ready for real development environments and better prepared for the job market.

marathon.name: High Performance – Fortaleza Marathon
marathon.desc: Preparation for the Fortaleza Marathon (April 2026) applying the same discipline and data-driven planning used in software projects — optimizing biomechanics, cadence, and nutrition.

star.s: Training for the Fortaleza Marathon required consistent performance gains and smart physical and nutritional resource management.
star.t: Optimize biomechanical efficiency and nutritional planning to achieve a sustainable, target race pace.
star.a: Maintained a cadence target of 180 BPM and implemented a strict per-hour strategy for carbohydrate and caffeine intake, tracking performance metrics just like software KPIs.
star.r: Built technical mastery over personal performance metrics, directly reflecting the same data-driven discipline applied to project planning and delivery.

uninassau.desc: Teaching Web Programming, Mobile Development (levels 1 & 2), and Configuration & Dependency Management. Focused on practical, real-world learning with modern tools.

master.desc: Focus on software factory processes and applied software engineering. Research partnership with Livox, developing assistive communication tools using AI, NLP, and computer vision.

bachelor.desc: Internship experience in networking, databases, and project micro-management. Two years of research in software engineering and algorithm analysis.
